text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I hope everyone finished their
homework. I'm
collecting it now!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(...Well, I actually did it this time. Get
ready to be
astounded by my genius—)

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
How about you, Sweep? If you didn't do
it this
time, you'll need to take an extra
class.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I was just about to give it to you!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
But now that you said that, I'm not
gonna! And
I'm not going to any extra
classes either! Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho brings her foul mood to
training,
and it ends up being quite a
disaster.
